I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It builds, and a run on both examples plus two extra cases printed the expected output. I ran it only with `wj run --compiled`, not as a separate `wj build`.

The extra cases I tried were `-7 2 /`, which gave `-3` (truncation toward zero), and a lone `-`, which gave `error: underflow`. A blank line between expressions was skipped.
